# Tasks in the form Myne writes

The only divergence from the Dataview dialect is `done` in place of Obsidian's
`completion` — one key, so the "third dialect" a reader must learn is one word.

- [ ] pay the rent [due:: 2026-08-01]
- [ ] water the plants [repeat:: every 3 days]
- [x] ship the release [done:: 2026-07-27]
- [ ] call mother [remind:: 2026-07-29 09:00]
- [ ] urgent thing [priority:: high]
- [ ] everything at once [due:: 2026-08-01] [priority:: highest] [remind:: 2026-07-31 08:00] [repeat:: every week] [done:: 2026-07-27]
- [ ] due with a time [due:: 2026-08-01 14:30]
